related.note: Both are about the UFO image in the Simpkinson Gemini material. This telling says a real UFO was airbrushed into or shown in the textbook, while Knuth's story says the original photo has no UFO and the image is a mock-up.

plain: A physicist and UFO researcher, Kevin Knuth, talks about a printed picture from Gemini 11, a 1966 NASA spaceflight, that seems to show a UFO and is tied to a NASA man named Scott Simpkinson. Knuth says a colleague, Ed Wilson, found the original photograph in the University of Arizona archives, showing Earth with the same cloud pattern but no UFO. That, as Knuth tells it, means the UFO in the printed version was likely added as a mock-up.
